setlist.title: Sitting on Top of the World
It's All Over Now Baby Blue
He Was A Friend of Mine

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue** (2 reviews): Very emotional version, with a spoken introduction by Babbs; Garcia gropes for the closing lyrics and seems to deliberately repeat a verse because he is so absorbed [3][8]
- **He Was A Friend of Mine** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out this song as a favorite; Extended version of a rarely played song, likened to Box of Rain in handling recent loss and tragedy [3][9]
- **Green Green Grass of Home** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes it as a very slow country song, with slow Garcia playing and decent Weir vocals; Reviewer calls it one of Weir's great stage moments, a fine ballad [6][12]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls it raw and fiery, recommended for listeners who like that rough style [6]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer recommends the Dark Star as proof the show is strong [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Green Grass**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **gd69-05-31.sbd.oleynick.76.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 142 min; rated 4.09/5 by 35 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound quality good enough; Reviewer says recording quality is not the best [8][13]
- **gd1969-05-31.167820.sbd.anon.gems.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 142 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]

## Around the show

- Follows Kesey's recent return to Oregon; free ice cream cones were handed out at the show [11]
- Stage banter before Green Green Grass of Home is singled out as worth hearing [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-05-31.sbd.oleynick.76.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by John Oleynick; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer's copy came through a trading contact shortly after Jerry died, said to have come from Garcia himself; Encore moved out of order so the show fits on two discs; nothing was cut, and original order can be restored [1][10]
- **gd1969-05-31.167820.sbd.anon.gems.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear); transferred by 2024 DAT transfer and mastering by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Minor repairs, track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Bear’s Ampex cassette (or possibly reel) SBD master > DAT (provided by Anon) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_47.html) [16]
- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_47.html) [17]
- Poster by gravitystereo: [Grateful Dead - Just Be Kind ( 2 CD SET ) ( McArthur Court Euguene, Oregon, May 31st, 1969 ) - gravitystereo](https://gravitystereo.com/product/grateful-dead-just-be-kind-2-cd-set-mcarthur-court-euguene-oregon-may-31st-1969/) [18]
- Poster by gravitystereo: [Grateful Dead - Just Be Kind ( 2 CD SET ) ( McArthur Court Euguene, Oregon, May 31st, 1969 ) - gravitystereo](https://gravitystereo.com/product/grateful-dead-just-be-kind-2-cd-set-mcarthur-court-euguene-oregon-may-31st-1969/) [19]
